nodes.label: A request comes in
nodes.note: By email, form, chat or file upload: whatever your team gets today.

nodes.label: Read and sorted
nodes.note: An AI step reads it, pulls out the key details and tags what kind of request it is.

nodes.label: Saved in one place
nodes.note: Everything lands in the sheet, customer list or database you already use.

nodes.label: Clear enough?
nodes.note: Simple rules decide: is anything missing or unusual?

nodes.label: Quick check by you
nodes.note: One click to approve in Slack or email, only when something is unclear.

nodes.label: Handled automatically
nodes.note: The routine work runs by itself: documents, replies, records updated.

nodes.label: Team updated
nodes.note: The right person gets a short message with everything they need.

nodes.label: Customer confirmed
nodes.note: A clear confirmation goes out right away, in your own wording.

nodes.label: Did it all work?
nodes.note: Every run is checked, nothing fails silently.

nodes.label: Alert with details
nodes.note: You get a short message: what failed, where, and what to do.

nodes.label: Tried again
nodes.note: Most small hiccups fix themselves on the second try.

nodes.label: Hours saved every week
nodes.note: The work is done and a simple weekly report shows the time saved.

nodes.label: Stopped safely
nodes.note: If it keeps failing, nothing is lost: it waits for you with all details saved.
